title: Module 6: Gagné's Nine Events of Instruction
description: Use Gagné's information-processing-grounded nine events as a diagnostic frame for the internal architecture of a single lesson.

learning_objectives.statement: Name and explain each of Gagné's nine events of instruction
Map a lesson to the nine events with appropriate time weighting
Diagnose a failing lesson by walking through each event and identifying which is missing or weak

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
